To find the total cubic yards of concrete needed for the continuous footing, including 7% waste:

1. **Convert all dimensions to feet:**
   - Length = $187\text{ ft}$
   - Width = $2\text{ ft } 7\text{ in} = 2 + \frac{7}{12}\text{ ft} = \frac{31}{12}\text{ ft}$
   - Depth = $1\text{ ft } 2\text{ in} = 1 + \frac{2}{12}\text{ ft} = \frac{14}{12}\text{ ft}$

2. **Calculate the volume in cubic feet:**
   $$\text{Volume} = 187 \times \frac{31}{12} \times \frac{14}{12} \approx 563.60\text{ cubic feet}$$

3. **Convert to cubic yards and add 7% waste:**
   $$\text{Cubic Yards} = \left(\frac{563.60}{27}\right) \times 1.07 \approx 22.34\text{ CY}$$

FINAL: 22.34 CY
